howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会依据《The Web Handbook》文档来回答：提供章节结构、关键概念、代码示例、表格、统计和文件导航等信息，供你在测试 golden html 时查阅。
howto.when: 当你在测试 golden html，或需要查阅该文档的概念、API、代码示例、教程等资料时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看《The Web Handbook》的章节结构。
say.note: Claude 会列出总章节数和各章节概览。

say.text: 这个文档里有 Python 代码示例吗？
say.note: Claude 会展示示例及其质量评分。

say.text: Getting Started 快速参考是什么？
say.note: Claude 会给出该部分的表格或要点。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses 'The Web Handbook' to answer: it provides section overviews, key concepts, code examples, tables, stats, and file navigation for testing the golden html build.
howto.when_en: Triggered when testing the golden html build, or when you need concepts, API references, code examples, or tutorials from this handbook.

say_en.text: Show me the section structure of The Web Handbook.
say_en.note: Claude lists the total sections and overview.
Claude shows examples with quality scores.

say_en.text: What is in the Getting Started quick reference?
say_en.note: Claude gives tables or points from that part.
